title: Smoother Skyblock trading on Bedrock
summary: Skyblock merchant menus now move reliably from Sell or Buy to resource and quantity selection on Bedrock.
body:
- Bedrock players no longer get trapped behind a server-data loading screen while navigating the Skyblock merchant.
- Sell and Buy now move cleanly through resource selection, quantity selection, and the final result.
- Closing or receiving an invalid native form response now releases that menu correctly, so it can be reopened immediately.
- Duplicate interaction signals are safely coalesced, and outdated merchant characters are consolidated automatically.
- Java inventory menus keep their existing loading and transaction safeguards.
